The ratio of the AM to the GM of two positive numbers a and b is 25 : 7. Find a : b.
items.markingKey: Let a = x², b = y² (x, y > 0); (x² + y²)/2 : xy = 25 : 7 (1) ⇒ 7x² − 50xy + 7y² = 0 (2); solving for x/y gives 7 (take the root > 1) (1) ⇒ a : b = 49 : 1 (1).

items.stem:
Gauri starts a savings challenge: put ₹1 in a piggy bank on day 1 and each day put double the previous day's amount.
(i) Name the type of sequence formed and write its first term and common ratio. (ii) How much is put in on day 6? (iii) What is the total saved in 6 days? (iv) Explain why this plan cannot go on for a whole month.
items.answer: (i) GP, a = 1, r = 2 (ii) ₹32 (iii) ₹63 (iv) amounts grow exponentially; day 30 alone would need ₹2²⁹, about ₹5.4 × 10⁸

items.stem:
Mehak wants to fence a rectangular kitchen garden of area 64 m² using the least length of fencing.
(i) If the sides are x m and y m, write xy and the perimeter. (ii) Use AM ≥ GM to show that x + y ≥ 16. (iii) Find the least perimeter and the shape that gives it. (iv) If the fencing costs ₹250 per metre, find the least cost.
items.answer: (i) xy = 64, perimeter 2(x + y) (ii) (x + y)/2 ≥ √(xy) = 8 (iii) 32 m, square of side 8 m (iv) ₹8,000
items.markingKey: (i) (1). (ii) AM ≥ GM (1). (iii) equality when x = y (1). (iv) least perimeter × rate (1).

items.stem: Which term of the sequence aₙ = 3n² + 7n is 370?
items.answer: the 10th term
items.markingKey: 3n² + 7n = 370 ⇒ 3n² + 7n − 370 = 0 (1); the positive integer root is n = 10 (1).
